basics.name: Cameron Wilby
basics.summary: A seasoned software developer with 10 years experience and a keen focus on product leadership.

work.summary: Performed full-stack development and upkeep for a US-based bankruptcy case management system.
highlights: Designed and implemented a module to calculate bond payment obligations for U.S. Bankruptcy Trustees.
Developed a new "Smart Grid" component to provide Excel-like editing capabilities for tabular data and released several batch editing features.
Designed and implemented a package to export billing data in Intuit Interchange Format (IIF) for import into QuickBooks Desktop.
Engaged in agile project management for a team of 5 developers.

work.summary: Contributed to the growth and success of multiple clients through specialized software development and strategic consulting.
highlights: Designed, architected, and developed a suite of web applications for LawSync, enhancing attorneys' ability to manage cases, collaborate securely with clients, and quickly generate required documents.
Independently developed iOS/Android applications for PMD Alliance, enabling members to easily locate exercise and support groups for Parkinson & movement disorders.
Engineered an educational game for GSI using Laravel/Angular, aimed at raising awareness about the duration of COVID-19 survival on various surfaces.

Successfully migrated Design West Engineering's Microsoft Access application to a comprehensive web portal, optimizing processes related to proposals/projects management, custom reports, and payroll management.
Developed a native web application for an on-site payment kiosk for Rowland Water District, enhancing customer experience and efficiency.

work.summary: Full stack development/maintenance for an automated email marketing platform.
highlights: Developed and maintained integrations with key third-party platforms including Stripe, Shopify, and ClickFunnels, significantly improving operational efficiency for Sendlane's user base.
Contributed to increasing test coverage and sufficiently built a CI workflow to automate quality control, resulting in a sharp decline in production issues.
Worked with the customer success team to effectively triage, repair, and resolve system bugs, significantly improving customer satisfaction.

work.summary: Co-founded a thriving coding academy, facilitating a rigorous 12-week development curriculum and cultivating a conducive learning environment.
highlights: Developed a comprehensive programming curriculum and conducted daily live-coding sessions for classes of 16 students, resulting in extensive student learning outcomes.
Established partnerships with local businesses to provide students with real-world projects, giving them practical industry experience.

work.summary: Full stack development/maintenance for a US-based bankruptcy case management system.
highlights: Built a portal for users to invite debtor attorneys to upload documents for a case.
Designed and implemented a system to automate case audits.
Learned .NET best practices and advanced web development techniques.
Fully remote team using Skype and screen sharing to facilitate standups and code review.

volunteer.summary: Presented talks on JavaScript and techniques for building web applications
highlights: Founded a fundamental JS meetup with coding exercises and focus on core Javascript fundamentals
